description: Searches YouTube videos by keyword and returns up to 20 videos (title, url, channel, published_at, views, duration, description), localized by country and language. It does not return transcripts (use youtube_transcript with a video ID), comments or channel pages. 5 credits per successful call; a search with no matches is charged, errors are not. Required: query.

country.description: Two-letter country code that localizes the videos, e.g. "it" or "gb". Omit for the source default, us.

language.description: Two-letter language code for the results, e.g. "en" or "it". Omit for the source default, en.

query.description: Video search text, 1-500 characters, e.g. "espresso tutorial".

results.description: Maximum videos returned, integer 1-20, default 10, e.g. 5.

name: search_youtube
title: Search YouTube
